candidate.description: A candidate segment the segment importer stages in the AppView before publishing it: a public line, such as an OpenStreetMap trail, validated as feed.segment is. Never served by any feed query, matched for efforts, or counted as a duplicate of a segment.

id.description: The importer's stable id for the candidate, of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

sport.description: The sport group whose activities count as its riders.

kind.description: As feed.segment#kind; absent means run. A lift must be in the alpine group.

line.description: The line from start to end as an encoded polyline at precision 6, as feed.segment#line.

source.description: Where the line came from, as feed.segment#source.

license.description: The licence of the line's data, as an SPDX identifier such as ODbL-1.0.

attribution.description: Who to credit for the line's data, as feed.segment#attribution. Blank is taken as none.

rejection.description: A staged candidate the AppView refused, and why.

duplicateCheck.description: A staged candidate checked against the live segments of its sport group, or an extracted dive site against the live dive sites (app.activitytracker.importer.checkDiveSites), and those it duplicates, by the duplicate test the AppView applies when indexing. Empty when it duplicates none.

candidate.description: The candidate as staged, which the importer publishes rather than any copy of its own.

sitePosition.description: An extracted dive site's id and centre, checked for duplicates before the importer publishes it.

id.description: The importer's stable id for the site, of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens: the rkey it is published under.

handoff.description: A removed active segment or dive site, kept so the segment importer can republish it under id (segments/segment-handoffs, dive-sites/site-handoffs). Holds only what its record held, never who rode or dived it, or its old creator. A segment carries sport, segmentKind and line; a site carries lat, lng and radius.

id.description: The record key the importer republishes it under.

name.description: The record's name, its original name. Adopted names carry over in the AppView, not in the record.

sport.description: A segment's sport group, as feed.segment#sport.

lat.description: A site's centre latitude, in 1e-7 degrees.

lng.description: A site's centre longitude, in 1e-7 degrees.

radius.description: A site's radius in whole metres, as feed.diveSite#radius.
